queries.query: large language model OR LLM "network configuration" OR "router configuration" OR NetOps
queries.rationale: Locate primary studies where LLMs are applied to generate full or partial network device configurations or intent-to-configuration translation.

queries.query: "intent to configuration" "network" "large language model" OR LLM OR GPT
queries.rationale: Target work specifically on translating natural-language intent into concrete network configuration or commands.

queries.query: "configuration repair" network "LLM" OR "large language model" OR "repair" "validate"
queries.rationale: Find literature on LLM- or ML-based configuration repair, propose–validate–repair loops, and iterative correction workflows.

queries.query: network configuration verification "Veriflow" OR "Header Space Analysis" OR NetKAT OR "formal verification"
queries.rationale: Survey deterministic/formal validators used in networking to serve as ground-truth or validators for LLM outputs.
Locate architectures and methods that pair LLM generation with external tools/validators and iterative repair strategies.

queries.query: LLM hallucinat* OR "incorrect" OR "unsafe" "network" OR "NetOps" OR "configuration"
queries.rationale: Document failure modes (hallucination, unsafe commands, missing preconditions) when LLMs produce operational artifacts.
source_preferences: security conferences (USENIX Security, CCS) for safety incidents

queries.query: benchmarks "network configuration" OR NetOps OR AIOps "LLM" OR "foundation model" benchmark dataset
queries.rationale: Identify existing benchmark suites, task banks, or dataset collections used to evaluate LLMs/AIOps in networking contexts and assess their scope and limitations.

queries.query: evaluation methods "operational correctness" network configuration "reachability" "policy compliance" "connectivity"
queries.rationale: Collect metrics and validators used to quantify correctness and safety of configs (reachability checks, ACL compliance, policy enforcement).

queries.query: simulation emulation Mininet GNS3 Cumulus "network config" evaluation "LLM"
queries.rationale: Find work using network emulation/simulation to test generated configs safely; identify testbeds and benchmarks for end-to-end evaluation.

queries.query: agentic AI OR autonomous agent "network operations" OR NetOps OR AIOps
queries.rationale: Survey agentic/autonomous frameworks that orchestrate multi-step NetOps workflows, including orchestration, tool use, planners, and guardrails.
Locate mitigation patterns and safety designs (rollback, canaries, dry-run, policy guards) for autonomous NetOps agents.
source_preferences: industry standards / whitepapers with reproducible evaluation

queries.rationale: Find meta-evaluation and methodological critiques about benchmark validity, construct validity, and ecological validity for LLM tasks applied to operations.

queries.query: nearest-neighbour work "LLM for NetOps" "AIOps" survey "systematic review"
queries.rationale: Identify recent surveys, systematic reviews, and literature mappings to position novelty and gaps.
Locate public datasets of real or synthetic network configurations, topology traces, and policy corpora that can serve as evaluation inputs or validators.

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference or journal papers, archival preprints (arXiv) with reproducible artifacts (code, datasets, or detailed methods).
Works that present empirical evaluation of LLMs or ML systems for NetOps tasks (configuration generation, repair, planning, validation) or that propose validators/emulators usable as ground-truth.
Papers describing formal/deterministic network verification tools (e.g., Header Space Analysis, Veriflow, NetKAT) and their evaluation.
Benchmarks, datasets, and tool papers with public artifacts or sufficient methodological detail to assess external/ecological validity.
Surveys, systematic reviews, or tutorial-style papers mapping LLM/AIOps methods in networking.
Engineering/artifact papers (Mininet, Batfish, realistic testbeds) that enable safe evaluation of generated configs.
exclusion_criteria: Vendor marketing collateral, product one-pagers, or blog posts without reproducible artifacts or verifiable experimental detail (unless they cite peer-reviewed sources or release data).
Papers that only evaluate generic NLP benchmarks with no operational NetOps task mapping or no measurable operational correctness metrics.
Proprietary datasets or closed-source evaluations where results cannot be independently assessed (unless the paper supplies sufficient verification or replication path).
Non-technical opinion pieces or editorials lacking empirical or methodological substance.
Works outside the NetOps/AIOps/operational domain unless they provide directly transferable methods for generation–validation–repair or agentic safety applicable to NetOps.
date_rationale: Search broadly across foundational networking verification literature (no strict lower bound) while prioritizing recent work (2020–2026) that engages with LLMs, agentic AI, and AIOps. Emphasize 2022–2026 for LLM-specific methods and safety research, but retain earlier foundational validators and benchmarks (e.g., Veriflow, HSA, NetKAT) for mechanism and comparator coverage.
